name: EPIC 229041912

text.card: A red giant 2,950 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.28 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,966 K at its surface.
